limitations: This interpretation covers only the four supplied sections in the default WHAT corpus: specification/GOALS.md, specification/INTENT.md and specification/PRODUCT.md. HOW, executable implementation, other project surfaces and external Products are outside the authored corpus.
The Intent concept and Product operation are kept distinct; no cross-document governing or identity-equivalence relation is inferred merely from similar wording.

Rounding is explicitly unresolved. Reproducibility has a stated intent but no supplied operational comparison criterion. Empty allowed-latitude arrays assert no permission for unspecified implementation choices.

This is current-session source interpretation. Grounded records and section dispositions do not establish semantic completeness, independent review, execution, acceptance or release; judgments, traversals and transformations are not instantiated.
